propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the monthly sample review of onboarding and suitability files against the monitoring plan, logging findings with severity and owner.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the monitoring review and the work sample shows a quarterly report built from it.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the ICA International Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance, awarded in 2021 and confirmed with the International Compliance Association.
propositions.rationale: The recruiter verification records confirmation of the award through the awarding body.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has more than ten years of compliance experience in regulated financial services.
propositions.rationale: The figure comes from a referrer's second-hand remark with no dates, employer record or role for the earlier bank job; the dated roles run from January 2019 to August 2026, seven years and eight months, and the qualification rule forbids stating N years of experience that no cited source establishes.

expectedGap: The dated compliance roles cover seven years and eight months, short of the eight-year requirement; the figure of over ten years comes from a referral and has no dated record.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified diploma, the dated roles and the documented monitoring, line-management and committee work; do not state more than ten years of compliance experience.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the employer, dates and duties of any compliance role before January 2019, including the bank role mentioned in the referral.
validClaimSignatures: Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance
